news.title: Predicting where wildfire smoke will go next
news.summary_en: A collaboration between UW–Madison researchers and Argonne National Laboratory is advancing new methods to improve air quality forecasting— and provide earlier warnings to the public.

news.title: 5 projects at UW–Madison aimed at transforming science and energy with AI receive DOE Genesis Mission funding
news.summary_en: The projects, spanning fusion to critical minerals, are among those awarded for accelerating breakthroughs using a new platform that combines AI, quantum systems, supercomputing and advanced scientific instruments.

news.title: Barber appointed to roles in Office of the Provost
news.summary_en: Sarah Barber has been appointed vice provost for academic affairs and chief of staff in the Office of the Provost.

news.title: UW–Madison chancellor search committee accepting nominations, applications
news.summary_en: Applicants should submit materials by September 10 for full consideration.

news.title: Three summer arts students, three unique experiences
news.summary_en: Summer arts courses at UW offer students a bonus season to earn valuable credits, expand their horizons and, in some cases, discover deeply personal stories.

news.title: The upside of online relationships
news.summary_en: UW–Madison professor Catalina Toma reveals the unexpected benefits of social media and dating apps.

news.title: July 20 campus cooling update
news.summary_en: Based on current information, repairs to the broken chilled water line are expected to be completed before students return for the fall semester.
